overview: The Wausau Board of Public Works held a brief meeting in which two claims were acted upon: one approved and one denied. The meeting concluded quickly with no extended discussion or public comment.

agenda.item: Claim of Aaron Isaac Munoz Granados — $9,878.62
Claim of John and Jennifer Havl — $180

discussions.item: Claim of Aaron Isaac Munoz Granados — $9,878.62
discussions.body: A motion was made and seconded to approve the claim of Aaron Isaac Munoz Granados in the amount of $9,878.62. The motion passed with no audible dissent. No discussion of the nature of the claim was captured in the transcript.

discussions.item: Claim of John and Jennifer Havl — $180
discussions.body: A motion was made and seconded to deny the claim of John and Jennifer Havl in the amount of $180. The motion to deny passed with no audible dissent. No explanation for the denial was provided in the transcript.
